title: Has Section 404 of the Sarbanes–Oxley Act Discouraged Corporate Investment? New Evidence from a Natural Experiment
eligible_reason: Single-date designs only. Table 1 (replicating prior work): US_POST_SOX vs NON_US_POST_SOX with a common post-SOX date, firm FE, time-varying controls (index return, GDP growth, EBIT, M/B and US interactions). Table 3 (natural experiment, small firms): xtreg y filer_post1 post1 + lagged EBIT/M/B controls and filer interactions + year dummies, fe, with post1 = fyear >= 2004 for every firm (T23_sample.dta: fyear 2002-2005 for both groups). Table 4 loan-level analog with loan controls. Not staggered; time-varying controls in every column.
design_notes: Stata xtreg, fe (default SEs). Data: T1_2006end.dta / T1_2002end.dta (firm-year, 1994-2006), T23_sample.dta (1,828 firm-years, filers vs non-filers 2002-2005), T4_loan.dta (DealScan loans).
data_files_note: Analysis-ready Compustat/CRSP/DealScan-derived files shipped; no README.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. Common SOX404 compliance date (FY2004) for the treated group; not staggered, not a near-miss.
